card.architecture: Deterministic OKLab palette + grid quantizer applied per frame (no model) — LoadVideo → GetVideoComponents → PixelQuantize → SaveAnimatedWEBP
card.summary: Pixel-quantizes every frame of a source clip onto a fixed grid + palette and re-encodes the clip at its own frame rate. No model, no VRAM. A locked (named) palette is the default so the colors are identical every frame — temporally consistent, no flicker. This is the only editor offered when the source is a video.
use_cases: turn a generated or uploaded clip into pixel-art video
deterministic frame-by-frame quantization with no diffusion redraw
card.pick_when: You have a video clip and want it pixel-quantized frame by frame.
